summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Macro Bank Inc., an Argentine foreign private issuer, reporting its first quarter 2026 earnings release. The filing contains routine financial results including net income of Ps. 139.8 billion, operating income, total financing, deposits, and capital adequacy ratios. It also mentions restructuring expenses (Ps. 12.9 billion after tax) but no specific event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The restructuring mention is vague and not the focus of the filing. Therefore, this is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation.
